{"33e39709-7b58-4a65-bef1-ac2a534a79d8": {"id": "33e39709-7b58-4a65-bef1-ac2a534a79d8", "name": "Cerberum", "description": "Cerbrum api", "swagger": "openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  description: |
    "The Genbrain TasksManager API orchestrates task managers and session management, specifically designed to empower groups to automate and execute tasks using generative AI models such as ChatGPT. Enhanced by robust tools and function calls, this API enables efficient task storage and monitoring, facilitating reuse and collaborative efforts across teams.
    Key features include the creation and management of task managers, as well as the ability to handle tasks and associated prompts. It supports operations such as updates, deletions, and retrievals of tasks and prompts, integrating these functions seamlessly into user workflows.
    Additionally, the API provides endpoints for initiating and managing ChatGPT sessions and executing function calls through a REST API proxy. It also features advanced logging and observability tools to monitor system interactions and ensure the transparency and reliability of operations."

  title: Genbrain TasksManager API
  version: 1.0.0
servers:

paths:
  /health_check:
    get:
      description:  |
            "This endpoint checks the health status of the service. It's a diagnostic tool used to ensure that the API is running and responsive.
            Role in System: Acts as a simple service monitoring tool that can be used for uptime checks or system diagnostics."
      summary: Check service if it's all good
      operationId: HealthCheck
      responses:
        "200":
          description: All OK
        "500":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Huston we have a problem
  /tasksmanager/{id}:
    delete:
      description: |
        "DELETE: Removes a specified tasksmanager by its ID. 
        This is critical for managing lifecycle events of task managers."
      operationId: DeleteTasksManager
      parameters:
        - description: ID of the tasksmanager to delete
          explode: false
          in: path
          name: id
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          style: simple
      responses:
        "204":
          description: TasksManager deleted
        "401":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Unauthorized
        "404":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: TasksManager not found
      summary: Delete a tasksmanager
    patch:
      description: |
        "Updates details for a specific tasksmanager. This allows modifications to 
        existing task managers to adapt to changing needs or corrections."
      operationId: UpdateTasksManager
      parameters:
        - description: ID of the tasksmanager to update
          explode: false
          in: path
          name: id
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          style: simple
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TasksManager'
        required: true
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/TasksManager'
          description: TasksManager updated
        "400":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Bad request
        "401":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Unauthorized
        "404":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: TasksManager not found
      summary: Update tasksmanager details
  /tasksmanager:
    get:
      description: |
        "Lists all tasks managers, potentially filtered by status, and supports pagination. This is essential for overviewing and managing multiple task 
        managers. Role in System: Central to creating and listing task managers, these endpoints facilitate the scaling and organization of tasks across various teams or projects."
      operationId: ListTasksManagers
      parameters:
        - description: Filter tasksmanagers by status
          explode: true
          in: query
          name: status
          required: false
          schema:
            title: name
            type: string
          style: form
        - description: Page number for pagination
          explode: true
          in: query
          name: page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 1
            type: integer
          style: form
        - description: Number of items per page
          explode: true
          in: query
          name: pageSize
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 10
            type: integer
          style: form
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ListTasksManagers'
          description: A list of tasksmanagers
        "400":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Bad request
        "500":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Internal server error
      summary: List all tasks managers
    post:
      description: |
        " Creates a new tasksmanager. This is a foundational operation that initializes the management of a new set of tasks.
          Central to creating and listing task managers, these endpoints facilitate the scaling and organization of tasks across various teams or projects."
      operationId: CreateTasksManager
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TasksManager'
        required: true
      responses:
        "201":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/TasksManager'
          description: TasksManager created
        "400":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Bad request
        "500":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Internal server error
      summary: Create a new tasksmanager
  /task:
    post:
      description: |
        "Creates a new task session, crucial for initiating operations or workflows designed to be handled by the task manager,
        task is a node in a tree structure of a tasksmanager."
      operationId: CreateTask
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        required: true
      responses:
        "201":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
          description: Task session created
        "400":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Bad request
        "500":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Internal server error
      summary: Create a new task session
  /task/{id}:
    get:
      description: |
        "Description: Retrieves details about a specific task by ID, including its current state and associated data.
        Role in System: Essential for detailed monitoring and management of specific tasks, enabling users to track progress and access task details."
      operationId: GetTaskById
      parameters:
        - description: ID of the task to get
          explode: false
          in: path
          name: id
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          style: simple
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
          description: Task found
        "404":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Task not found
        "500":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Huston we have a problem
      summary: Get task by ID
    delete:
      description: |
        "Deletes a specific task by its ID, important for managing the lifecycle and 
        cleanup of tasks. task is a node in a tree structure of a tasksmanager."
      operationId: DeleteTask
      parameters:
        - description: ID of the task to delete
          explode: false
          in: path
          name: id
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          style: simple
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Task deleted
        "404":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Task not found
        "500":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Huston we have a problem
      summary: Delete task by ID

  /task/{tasksmanager_id}/{task_id}/run:
    post:
      description: |
        "Description: Executes a specific task associated with a tasksmanager. This endpoint allows for the operational execution of defined tasks, with optional configurations.
        Role in System: Acts as the execution arm of the system, triggering active task processes and potentially utilizing configured toolsets."
      summary: Run an tasksmanager task
      operationId: runTask
      parameters:
        - name: tasksmanager_id
          in: path
          required: true
          description: ID of the tasksmanager
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: task_id
          in: path
          required: true
          description: ID of the task
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Run completed successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskRunSession'
        '400':
          description: Type Error in request
        '404':
          description: Task or tasksmanager not found
        '409':
          description: Conflict with the module's expected attributes
        '422':
          description: Unsupported task type or configuration error
        '501':
          description: Requested service is not implemented
        '500':
          description: Internal Server Error
  /tasksmanager/{tasksmanager_id}/run:
    post:
      description: |
        "Description: Triggers all tasks under a specific tasksmanager to run, effectively managing batch operations.
        Role in System: Facilitates bulk task operations, enhancing efficiency by allowing multiple tasks to be executed simultaneously."
      summary: Run all tasks for an tasksmanager
      operationId: runAllTasksManagerTasks
      tags:
        - TasksManager
      parameters:
        - name: tasksmanager_id
          in: path
          required: true
          description: ID of the tasksmanager
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '202':
          description: TasksManager tasks run accepted
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/TasksManagerRunSession'
        '404':
          description: TasksManager not found

  /toolsets:
    get:
      description: |
        "Description: Lists all available toolsets, which can be utilized across tasks and tasks managers.
        Role in System: Provides a comprehensive overview of available toolsets, enabling users to select and configure tools for specific tasks."
      operationId: listToolsets
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Toolsets listed successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Toolset'
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
    post:
      description: |
        "Description: Creates a global toolset, which can be utilized across various tasks and tasks managers.
        Role in System: Provides a mechanism to define and reuse configurations and tools across tasks, promoting consistency and efficiency."
      operationId: createGlobalToolset
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Toolset'
        required: true
      responses:
        "201":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Toolset'
          description: Global toolset created successfully.
        "400":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Invalid request data or validation error.
        "401":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Unauthorized - authentication is required to access this endpoint.
        "500":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          description: Internal server error.
      summary: Create a new global toolset.

  /toolsets/{toolset_id}:
    get:
      description: |
        "Description: Retrieves details about a specific toolset by ID, including its configuration and associated data.
        Role in System: Essential for detailed monitoring and management of specific toolsets, enabling users to access and configure tools for tasks."
      operationId: getToolsetById
      parameters:
        - name: toolset_id
          in: path
          required: true
          description: ID of the toolset
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Toolset found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Toolset'
        '404':
          description: Toolset not found
        '500':
          description: Internal server error

  /agent:
    post:
      summary: Create agents and tasks
      description: Create agents with specified tools and tasks using a JSON payload.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateCrewRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Job Posting Creation Process Completed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  message:
                    type: string
                  result:
                    type: string
        '400':
          description: Invalid input
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  detail:
                    type: string
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  detail:
                    type: string
  /agent/{id}/run:
    post:
      summary: Run an agent

      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          description: The unique identifier of the agent
      requestBody:
        description: The message to send to the agent
        required: false
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                message:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Message'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Agent run completed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  message:
                    type: string
                  result:
                    type: string
        '404':
          description: Agent not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  detail:
                    type: string
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  detail:
                    type: string

  /state/save:
    post:
      summary: Save application state
      description: |
        Saves the current application state to a specified storage type
        manage the persistence and retrieval of system state, crucial for disaster recovery, system migrations, or replicating setups across environments.""
      operationId: saveState
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/StorageLocation'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: State saved successfully.
        '400':
          description: Bad request due to missing or invalid data.

  /state/load:
    post:
      summary: Load application state
      description: |
        Retrieves the state data from specified storage and optionally saves it into another location or returns it.
        Loads a saved state from specified storage, which can be optionally output as JSON.
        Role in System: These endpoints manage the persistence and retrieval of system state, crucial for disaster recovery, system migrations, or replicating setups across environments.
      operationId: loadState
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/StorageLocation'
        - in: query
          name: return_as_json
          schema:
            type: boolean
            default: true
          description: Flag to return the state as JSON instead of saving it to a location.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: State loaded successfully and applied to memory.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: true
        '404':
          description: State not found.
  /write_code:
    post:
      summary: Write code to a file
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/SaveFileRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: File saved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  message:
                    type: string
                    example: File saved successfully
        '500':
          description: Internal Server Error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/HTTPError'
  /run_code:
    post:
      summary: Run code from a file
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/RunFileRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Execution output
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  output:
                    type: string
                    example: Hello, World!
        '500':
          description: Internal Server Error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/HTTPError'

components:
  parameters:
    StorageLocation:
      in: query
      name: storage_location
      schema:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/StorageLocation'

  schemas:
    Error:
      properties:
        code:
          format: int32
          title: code
          type: integer
        message:
          title: message

        fields:

        error_type:
          title: error_type
          type: string
        details:
          additionalProperties: true
          title: details
          type: object
      title: Error

      properties:
        role:
          description: "The role of the entity that is creating the message. Possible values are 'system', 'user', 'assistant', and 'tool'."
          enum:
            - system
            - user
            - assistant
            - tool
          title: role
          type: string
        content:
          description: The content of the message.
          title: content
          type: string
        file_ids:
          default: []
          description: A list of File IDs that the message should use. Useful for tools that can access and use files.
          items:
            type: string
          maxItems: 10
          type: array
      required:
        - content
        - role
      title: Message
    Task:
      type: object
      title: Task

        id:
          type: string
          description: Unique identifier for the task
          nullable: true
        name:

          nullable: true

          type: string
          description: Identifier for the tasksmanager assigned to the task

          type: string
          description: Detailed description of the task

        created_at:

        updated_at:

          format: date-time

          type: string
        configurations:
          additionalProperties: true
          title: configurations
          type: object
        created_at:
          format: date-time
          title: created_at
          type: string
        updated_at:
          format: date-time

        messages:
          items:

          type: array
        toolsets:
          description: Optional array of toolset IDs to be used for this task.

            type: string

        - name

    ListTasksManagers:
      properties:
        tasksmanagers:
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TasksManager'
          type: array
      title: ListTasksManagers
    Toolset:

          title: name
          type: string
        system:
          title: system
          type: string
        description:
          title: description
          type: string
        swagger_str:
          description: Swagger definition as a string.
          title: swagger
          type: string

          type: string
        response:
